questions.prompt: What is the sum of the eigenvalues of any square matrix equal to?
options: The trace (sum of diagonal entries) of the matrix
questions.explanation: A fundamental theorem of linear algebra proves that the sum of the eigenvalues equals the trace of the matrix.

questions.prompt: What is the Laplace transform of the unit step function u(t)?
questions.explanation: The integral from 0 to infinity of e^(-st) * 1 dt evaluates to 1/s for s > 0.
